request.description: Undoes a merge: moves back exactly the rows the merge moved, restores contact flags and reactivates the merged party. Rows added to the survivor afterwards stay there. Refused once reverted or if either party changed state since. Staff only; reading needs party read access, deciding and merging need party update access (ops lead, ops reviewer). A merge moves everything attached to the merged party to the survivor in one transaction: contacts (duplicates stay behind, their verified and do-not-contact flags carry over), identifiers, relationships, the login and organization (refused when both parties have one), facts, answers, consent records and requests, and leads. The merged party is kept with status `merged`, and the merge can be reverted.
